page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-4-lssd is a general-purpose cloud instance built on dedicated Intel Xeon 8481C processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by 105 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector and matrix acceleration instructions, including Intel AVX-512, VNNI, and AMX tile operations.

The instance comes equipped with 16.0 GB of memory, representing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include 402 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency host-level disk I/O. The node does not include dedicated GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 network addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate moderate single-threaded performance, with average scores across stress-ng single-core tests, Geekbench single-core execution, and gzip single-threaded compression. Multi-threaded compute benchmarks and memory bandwidth metrics reflect lower percentile performance under parallel workloads, as seen in bzip3 multi-threaded decompression and PassMark multi-core evaluations. Static web serving throughput reaches 6.5 GB/sec, while Redis SET operations achieve 4.23 million operations per second.

Given its balance of 16 GB RAM and bundled local NVMe SSD storage, c3-standard-4-lssd provides qualitative efficiency for I/O-sensitive workloads that do not require dense parallel core counts. Recommended workloads include static web serving, local caching layers, light database nodes, and general staging environments.
